item_name: Rothco Thin Red, Blue, and Green Line US Flag - 3' x 5'
item_short_desc: Show your support for law enforcement officials, firefighters, and military personnel through Rothco’s Thin Red, Blue, Green Line United States Flag.
description: Show your support for law enforcement officials, firefighters, and military personnel through Rothco’s Thin Red, Blue, Green Line United States Flag. Honor active military service members and veterans, firefighters, and police inside or out of your home with this support flag. Our United States thin red, blue, green line flag can be displayed proudly and securely through metal grommets, which seek to prevent against tearing. This law enforcement, firefighter and military support flag is constructed with a durable polyester material to withstand natural outdoor elements and preserve flag integrity. This United States thin red, blue and green line flag is sewn with a well-made double stitch, providing a stronger seam to keep this American flag from fraying. Proceeds From this purchase benefit families of fallen first responders.
